Class CreateLobbyDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.stage.Window
javafx.stage.Stage
view.widgets.CreateLobbyDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
public class CreateLobbyDialog extends javafx.stage.Stage
Popup view that shows after the user clicks the button 'create new lobby'. It gives the user the ability to choose the size of the lobby from 2 to 5 players. Once the user clicks the button 'create' its sends back the number of player chosen by the player. Once the user clicks the button 'cancel' the popup disappears.
